label.zh: 开局：乘客满意度局势开始
label.en: Game start: the Passenger Satisfaction situation begins

opening.evidence: hidden nomads.1000 (events/nomads_events_1.txt:6023) starts situation_passenger_satisfaction at game start; permanent bidirectional situation, initial progress 500 (common/situations/14_nomads_situations.txt:5-44).

label.zh: 局势阶段（由进度决定，可来回）
label.en: Situation stages (set by progress, can swing both ways)

note.zh: 进度双向：≤1时登岸（失败结局），满时船员接管（叛乱结局）；中间：愤怒、无聊、平稳、超负荷、紧绷，各首次进入时出现一次。
note.en: Progress moves both ways. At 1 or less: Planetfall (fail ending). At full: Crew Takeover (mutiny ending). Between: incensed, bored, steady, overworked, stressed, each once on first entry.

note.zh: 进度降至最低：乘客登岸，局势被销毁。
note.en: Progress at its minimum: the passengers land and the situation is destroyed.

note.zh: 进度满：船员叛乱，局势被销毁。
note.en: Progress full: the crew mutinies and the situation is destroyed.

notes.zh: 每月事件1055（乘客分心）与1255（避免兵变）由局势的月度钩子随机触发。
notes.en: Monthly hooks of the situation fire 1055 (Passengers Distracted) and 1255 (Mutiny Averted) (common/situations/14_nomads_situations.txt:555-556).

uncertain: Approach effects (crew / balanced / passenger) change modifiers and progress but not the event list; the conditions of 1055 and 1255 were not read.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这艘旗舰的名称。
note.en: In the game, this flagship's name appears here.
